figures.label: march_recognised_revenue_cents
figures.query: SELECT SUM(amount_cents) FROM revenue_event WHERE recognised_on >= '2026-03-01' AND recognised_on < '2026-04-01'
figures.second_derivation: SELECT SUM(i.amount_cents) - COALESCE(SUM(r.refunded_cents), 0) FROM invoice i LEFT JOIN refund r ON r.invoice_id = i.invoice_id WHERE i.issued_on >= '2026-03-01' AND i.issued_on < '2026-04-01'
